about: Typed by hand from the Degradation Fee Schedule box on page 11 of 12 of the CDOT 2026 Permit Fee Schedule (the same PDF as source.json, sha256 009061e5936dd3335048de2e8b5ccceb216a2504c1b568e12c7dad2209fcd9b7). That box is an image in the PDF, so pdftotext does not extract it; every value here must be checked against that page by eye.
page: Page 11 of 12 (PDF page 13), III. Additional Fees, A. Degradation Fees
appliesTo: projects involving cuts or trenches in a public street when the pavement surface is less than five (5) years old (Moratorium street); assessed in addition to the required permit fee

multiplier.label: More than 6 and up to 12 months
More than 12 and up to 18 months
More than 18 and up to 24 months
More than 24 months, up to 5 years

examples.case: a 6 by 6 foot opening (1) in a street paved 6 months ago
a 250 foot trench in a street paved 4 and a half years ago

exemption: Residential homeowners are exempt on repairs to existing sewer and water services in the right-of-way.
